translations.text: He shall remove its crop with the food in it and throw it beside the altar on the east side, in the place for the ashes.
Break it into pieces and pour oil over it. It is [?] fine flour.
And the two kidneys and the fat on them, which is on the flanks, and the lobe of the liver with the kidneys, he shall [?].

The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the Lord in the tent of meeting. He shall pour out all the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering, at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
He shall separate all its fat from it and offer it up on the altar.

If he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he shall bring as his offering for the sin he committed a tenth of a seah of fine flour as a sin offering. He shall not pour oil on it or put frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
The priest shall put on linen garments and wear linen clothing against his body. He shall remove the ashes left when the fire consumed the burnt offering on the altar and place them beside the altar.
The fire shall keep burning on the altar and shall not go out. The priest shall heap wood on it every morning, arrange the burnt offering on it, and offer up the fat of the peace offerings on it.
He shall present all its fat from it: the fat tail and the fat covering the internal organs.
Speak to the Israelites and tell them: Whoever presents a peace sacrifice to the Lord shall bring his offering to the Lord from the sacrifice of the burnt offering.
This is the anointing portion of Aaron and the anointing portion of his sons from the Lord’s offerings, on the day he is brought forward to serve the Lord.
Moses took them from their hands and offered them up on the altar, burning them with the burnt offering, so that they would be an ordination offering with a pleasing aroma, an offering to the Lord.
Fire came out from before the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord.
You shall teach the Israelites all the statutes that the Lord spoke to them through Moses.
Every animal that walks on its paws, among all the animals that walk on four legs, is unclean for you. Anyone who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.
If water falls on seed and any of their carcasses falls on it, it is unclean for you.
For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt to be your God. You shall be holy, because I am holy.
If leprosy spreads over his skin and covers all his skin, from his head to his feet, wherever the priest can see,
The priest shall examine it on the seventh day. If the bright spot has spread in the skin, the priest shall declare it unclean, because it is a lesion of leprosy.
If a man or a woman has a bright, white spot on the skin of their body,
If his hair falls out at the front of his head, he is bald at the forehead; he is clean.
The priest shall examine the affected spot, and the priest shall isolate it for seven days.
He shall burn the garment, or the warp or the weft of wool or linen, or any leather article in which the affected spot appears. He shall burn it in fire, because it is malignant leprosy.
If the priest sees that the affected spot has faded after it was washed, he shall cut it out of the garment or the leather, or out of the warp or the weft.
This shall be the law concerning a person with leprosy on the day he is cleansed: he shall be brought to the priest.
The priest shall take one measure of oil and pour it into the priest’s left hand.
The priest shall give orders, and they shall remove the stones that have the leprous infection in them and throw them outside the town in an unclean place.
They shall scrape the inside of that house all around and throw the plaster they have scraped off outside the town in an unclean place.

He shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the eastern face of the atonement cover. In front of the atonement cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood seven times with his finger.
He shall offer the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
For on this day atonement shall be made for you, so that you may be cleansed from all your sins. Before the Lord you shall be clean.
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife, for it is your father’s nakedness.
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether born to your father or to another man.
You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, or approach her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover their nakedness. They are close relatives, and it is wickedness.
When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap the edges of your fields completely, and you shall not gather the gleanings of your harvest.
You shall not slander your people, and you shall not act against your neighbor’s life, for I am the Lord.
If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall certainly be put to death, because they have committed a sin. Their blood is on their own heads.
If a man sleeps with an animal, he shall certainly be put to death, and the animal shall also be stoned.
Keep all my commandments and my judgments, and carry them out, so that the land into which I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
When a priest’s daughter begins to prostitute herself, she defiles her father. She shall be burned with fire.
No man among the descendants of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the Lord’s offering. Because he has a defect, he shall not approach to present the food of his God.
The Israelites shall not profane the holy offerings that they set apart for the Lord.
You shall not profane my holy name, so that I may be sanctified among the Israelites. I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
Present an offering to the Lord for seven days. On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly, and you shall not do any ordinary work.
Count for yourselves from the day after that day, from the day when you bring the sheaf set apart as an offering. There shall be seven complete [?] weeks.
Speak to the Israelites and tell them: On the first day of the seventh month, you shall have a day of rest and a memorial proclaimed with a trumpet blast. You shall have a sacred assembly.
On the first day, take for yourselves fruit from beautiful trees: citrons, palm fronds, myrtle, and willows. Rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days, all of you of the house of Israel.
Celebrate this festival to the Lord for seven days each year. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations. Celebrate it in the seventh month.
He shall arrange the lamps on the great lampstand before the Lord continually.
On the sixth day Aaron shall arrange them before the Lord continually, on behalf of the Israelites, as an everlasting covenant.
They held him in custody so that the Lord’s own word would make the matter clear to them.
Fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has injured his neighbor, so it shall be done to him.
The Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai and said to him:
If you say, “What shall we eat in the seventh year, since we will neither sow nor gather its crops?”
If your brother becomes poor and sells some of his inherited property, his nearest relative shall come and redeem what his brother sold.
If many years still remain, he shall pay back his redemption price in proportion to them, based on the money paid for him.
I will scatter you among the nations and draw a sword after you. Your land shall become a wasteland, and your towns shall become ruins.
If the person who consecrated the field redeems it, he shall add one-fifth of its value in silver to its price, and it shall be his.
